common_declaration.description: This dictionary details every insurance's premium and its coverage, typicaly this includes severa insurance details on single page and there total coverage this typically shown only on starting of the document i.e page number 1,2,3

schema.Coverages_and_Premium: Coverages and Premium of each insurace in this document
schema.total_policy_premium_ammount: Ammount of total policy premium combined

Commercial Auto.description: This dictionary encapsulates every piece of information collected on a standard auto insurance application, including policy details, applicant/co-applicant data, vehicle and driver information, coverage selections, insurance history, loss records, supplemental questions, and signatures/attachments.

general_policy_info.agency_name: Name of agency submitting the application

drivers.school_distance_gt_100mi_YN: Student attends school >100 miles from home? (Y/N)

coverages.applies_to_vehicle_VIN: VIN of the vehicle this coverage applies to (or 'ALL')

Homeowners.description: This dictionary encapsulates every piece of information collected on a standard homeowners insurance application...

named_insureds.city: City of the insured's mailing address
named_insureds.state: State of the insured's mailing address
named_insureds.zip_code: ZIP code of the insured's mailing address

applicant_details.years_at_current_address: Number of years at the current address
applicant_details.previous_address: Previous address if less than 3 years at current address

property_information.location_city: City where the insured property is located
property_information.location_state: State where the insured property is located
property_information.location_zip_code: ZIP code of the insured property
property_information.location_county: County where the insured property is located
property_information.purchase_date: Date when the property was purchased
property_information.square_footage: Total square footage of the living area
property_information.number_of_stories: Number of stories in the building
property_information.roof_age: Age of the roof in years
property_information.heating_type: Type of heating system (e.g., Gas, Electric)
property_information.replacement_cost: Estimated replacement cost of the property

coverage_limits.loss_of_use_coverage_limit: Coverage limit for loss of use
coverage_limits.endorsements: List of endorsements added to the policy
coverage_limits.estimated_total_premium: Estimated total premium for the policy

risk_safety_features.fire_alarm_type: Type of fire alarm system (Local, Central)
risk_safety_features.burglar_alarm_type: Type of burglar alarm system (Local, Central)

additional_interests.name: Name of the mortgagee or additional insured
additional_interests.loan_number: Loan number associated with the interest
additional_interests.interest_type: Type of interest (Mortgagee, Additional Insured, Loss Payee)

loss_history.prior_insurer_name: Name of the prior insurance company
loss_history.prior_policy_number: Policy number of the prior insurance
loss_history.prior_policy_expiration_date: Expiration date of the prior policy
loss_history.losses_in_last_5_years: Any losses in the last 5 years (Yes/No)
loss_history.coverage_declined_or_cancelled: Any coverage declined or cancelled in the last 3 years (Yes/No)

general_information.business_conducted_on_premises: Any business conducted on the premises (Yes/No)
general_information.flood_or_fire_hazard: Property located in flood or fire hazard area (Yes/No)
general_information.animals_on_premises: Presence of animals on the premises (Yes/No)
general_information.trampoline_on_premises: Presence of a trampoline on the premises (Yes/No)
general_information.uncorrected_fire_or_building_code_violat: Any uncorrected fire or building code violations (Yes/No)

attachments_signatures.date_signed: Date when the application was signed
attachments_signatures.attachments_included: List of any attachments included with the application

Commercial Property.description: A nested Python dictionary representing ACORD 125 and 140 data for a commercial policy...

ACORD_125_applicant_info.business_structure: Entity type (e.g., Corp, LLC, Sole Prop)
ACORD_125_applicant_info.years_in_business: How many years the business has been operating
ACORD_125_applicant_info.contact_person: Main contact person for the business
ACORD_125_applicant_info.inspection_contact_name: Name of the contact for inspections

locations.location_address: Physical address of the insured location
locations.year_built: Year the building was originally constructed
locations.number_of_stories: Number of stories in the building
locations.square_footage: Total square footage of the structure
locations.watchmen_or_security: Any security guards or systems in place
locations.other_occupancies: Description of other business uses in the building

Workers Compensation.description: A nested Python dictionary capturing ACORD 125, 130, and related sections for a workers' compensation application...

ACORD_125_applicant_info.business_structure: Entity type (e.g., Corp, LLC, Sole Prop)
ACORD_125_applicant_info.years_in_business: How many years the business has been operating

ACORD_130_general_info.other_entity_names: Any additional entities included in coverage
ACORD_130_general_info.states_to_cover: States where WC coverage is needed

individuals_inclusion_exclusion.name: Name of owner, partner, officer
individuals_inclusion_exclusion.title: Title or relationship
individuals_inclusion_exclusion.included_or_excluded: Whether included or excluded from WC

General Liability.description: A nested Python dictionary capturing ACORD 125, 126, and related sections for a commercial general liability application...

ACORD_125_applicant_info.insured_name: Legal name of the business or entity
ACORD_125_applicant_info.business_structure: Entity type (e.g., Corporation, LLC, Partnership, etc.)

ACORD_126_general_info.deductible_type: Type of deductible (Per Claim / Per Occurrence)
ACORD_126_general_info.other_deductible_description: If other, describe and specify deductible

ACORD_126_limits.general_aggregate_limit: Maximum total for all claims in policy period
ACORD_126_limits.products_completed_operations_aggregate_: Max for products & completed operations claims
ACORD_126_limits.personal_advertising_injury_limit: Limit for personal or advertising injury claims
ACORD_126_limits.medical_expense_limit: Limit for medical expense per person

contractors_info.type_of_work_subcontracted: What type of work is subcontracted
contractors_info.subcontractors_carry_lower_limits: Do they carry lower limits than required? (Y/N)
contractors_info.design_or_supervise_for_fee: Design, supervise, manage for a fee? (Y/N)

products_completed_operations.intended_use: Description of how product is used

additional_interests.name: Name of mortgagee, loss payee, etc.

Umbrella Excess.description: A nested Python dictionary capturing ACORD 125 and 131 sections for a commercial umbrella/excess liability application...

ACORD_125_applicant_info.years_in_business: How long the business has been operating

ACORD_131_limits.umbrella_limit_requested: Total umbrella or excess limit requested

underlying_policies.type: General Liability / Auto Liability / Employers Liability / Other
underlying_policies.carrier: Insurance carrier for the underlying policy

additional_interests.name: Name of additional insured or interest
additional_interests.interest_type: Type of interest (e.g., Additional Insured, Mortgagee)

Cyber Liability.description: A nested Python dictionary capturing key fields for a cyber liability insurance application...

applicant_info.business_structure: Type of business entity (LLC, Corp, etc.)
applicant_info.years_in_business: Number of years the business has operated

policy_info.prior_policy_expiration_date: Expiry date of prior policy (if applicable)

exposure_info.data_encryption_YN: Are records encrypted at rest and in transit? (Y/N)
exposure_info.backups_frequency: Frequency of data backups (Daily, Weekly, etc.)
exposure_info.incident_response_plan: Do you have an incident response plan? (Y/N)

prior_cyber_claims.description: Details of the cyber loss or breach

requested_coverages.business_interruption: Coverage for lost income from downtime (Y/N)
requested_coverages.dependent_business_interruption: BI loss due to vendor failure (Y/N)

Professional Liability.description: A nested Python dictionary capturing key fields for an Errors & Omissions (E&O) liability insurance application...

operations_services_info.percentage_of_services_by_type: Breakdown by service category (% consulting, % design, etc.)
operations_services_info.subcontractor_insurance_requirements: Do you require subcontractors to carry E&O? (Y/N)
operations_services_info.use_of_disclaimers_or_limitations: Use of client disclaimers or limitation-of-liability clauses? (Y/N)

client_management_info.written_contract_used_YN: Are written contracts used with clients? (Y/N)
client_management_info.contract_reviewed_by_legal_YN: Are contracts reviewed by legal counsel? (Y/N)
client_management_info.use_of_independent_quality_control: Is there a quality control process in place? (Y/N)

risk_management_practices.employee_training_program_YN: Formal employee training program in place? (Y/N)
risk_management_practices.client_screening_process_YN: Do you vet or screen clients? (Y/N)
risk_management_practices.regulatory_compliance_YN: Is business subject to regulatory oversight? (Y/N)

requested_coverages.copyright_infringement_coverage: Coverage for IP or copyright issues (Y/N)

attachments_signatures.loss_run_attached: Are loss runs from prior carriers attached? (Y/N)

Directors & Officers.description: A nested Python dictionary capturing key fields for a Directors & Officers (D&O) liability insurance application...

applicant_info.business_structure: Entity type (Corp, LLC, Non-profit, Public, Private)

financial_info.public_filings_YN: Any pending or recent SEC filings? (Y/N)

litigation_history.known_incidents_YN: Knowledge of any incidents that could give rise to claims? (Y/N)
litigation_history.bankruptcy_or_insolvency_YN: Any history of bankruptcy or insolvency? (Y/N)
litigation_history.merger_acquisition_activity_YN: Any M&A activity in last 12 months? (Y/N)

corporate_governance.independent_directors_present_YN: Are there independent directors on the board? (Y/N)
corporate_governance.audit_committee_YN: Does company have an audit committee? (Y/N)
corporate_governance.risk_management_procedures_YN: Are formal risk controls in place? (Y/N)

requested_coverage.Side_A_limit: Limit requested for Side A coverage
requested_coverage.Side_B_limit: Limit requested for Side B coverage
requested_coverage.coverage_for_outside_directorships_YN: Coverage for D&Os serving other boards? (Y/N)

attachments_signatures.list_of_directors_officers_attached: Full list of directors and officers included? (Y/N)
